admission.justification: Optional-field compatibility prevents existing task documents from becoming uneditable after an additive schema change and prevents a presentation-only dependency field from accidentally gaining authority over task starts or closeout.

applicability: Task documents authored before waitsFor, nonGoals, acceptance and completedAt were added, throughout loading, rendering and ordinary edits.
conditions: The newly optional fields need not be supplied.
Dependency display is informative and adds no task-start or lifecycle-readiness gate.
Existing document kind, review and step-operation meanings are preserved.
exclusions: The explicitly authorized task-local migration of this master’s open tasks.
Changing closeout obligations for major steps or their children.
statement: Documents predating the new optional fields still load, render and accept ordinary edits without supplying those fields, and dependency display does not add a task-start or lifecycle-readiness gate.
